_about: Lookalike patterns for the week of 23 November 2026, written by the Sunday ideas run on 2026-11-16 from lookalike-input.json (100 posts, feed fallback). Only each post's headline was in the input (no summary, caption or slides came through the fallback), so the card flows below are read from the headlines and the accounts' usual carousel shape, not from the slides themselves. Feed fallback: the Instagram inspo sheet could not be read (the Posts tab has no published, retrieved, headline, post url column); the patterns come from the feed the gather read (inspiration.lookalike_feed). Stale sheet: the gathered feed's newest row is 2026-11-11, more than 3 days before 2026-11-16; the patterns lean on older posts.

patterns.pattern: AI solves a small, very human everyday problem in a way nobody expected, told as a before and after.
patterns.why_it_travels: Everyone has lost an earbud or been annoyed by bad recommendations; the post is a story people retell and a trick they can try tonight.
card_flow: the small disaster, shown as a photo that stops the scroll
what the person asked the AI, word for word
what the AI did, step by step
the result, with proof
how you can do the same tonight
